payload.reason: The evidence provides specific examples of state-of-the-art baselines in the context of SQL generation from natural language queries, detailing the models and their adaptations.

claims.text: State-of-the-art baselines include Context-dependent Seq2Seq (CD-Seq2Seq) and SyntaxSQL-con, which are adapted for SQL generation tasks.
Recent advancements in state-of-the-art performance include models that utilize recursive decoding, graph neural networks, and intermediate representations for bridging natural language and SQL.
